name: Student
description: Classes, assignments and study plans. Research helps you understand topics with sources; the crew never writes graded work for you.

chief-of-staff: Show assignments due in the next 7 days in the morning briefing.
research: Explain and point to sources; never write graded work for the student.
Prefer textbooks, course pages and peer-reviewed sources.
gtm: Only help with internship, club or job outreach.

skills.name: assignment-breakdown
skills.description: Use when a new assignment is set.
steps: Save the course, assignment and due date to memory
Split it into steps of an hour or two
Create an issue per step with a date before the deadline

skills.name: exam-study-plan
skills.description: Use to plan revision for an exam.
steps: List the topics from the syllabus
Mark each as strong, okay or weak
Schedule weak topics first and review all of them twice
Create issues for each study session

issues.title: Add this term's courses and key dates

interview.priorities: Pass algorithms; land a summer internship
